mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_account_ledger (tenant_id, account_id, customer_id, txn_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotent_key, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{accountId}, #{customerId}, #{txnType}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{idempotentKey}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, account_id, customer_id, txn_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotent_key, create_time FROM openbiz_account_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, account_id, customer_id, txn_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotent_key, create_time FROM openbiz_account_ledger WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
